q: What do we know about feat-velocity-v2?
key: 30-day velocity features (v2) built on cards.txn_daily; their window ran past the observation date, so they leaked the target (AUC 0.81→0.74 without it); superseded by feat-velocity-v3; used by exp-014 and churn-xgb-v2.

It became churn-xgb-v2 (AUC 0.81); the jump was suspected (leak-hypothesis), checked in exp-017 (AUC 0.74 without post-period days), confirmed as post-period-leak; decision to rebuild velocity as v3; feat-velocity-v3 → churn-xgb-v3 (AUC 0.76, recall@10 0.43).
Features feat-velocity-v2, feat-velocity-v3, feat-utilization-v1; the label table cards.churn_labels; and through them the models churn-xgb-v2, churn-xgb-v3 (and logreg-baseline via the labels).

q: What is the current production churn model and how good is it?
key: churn-xgb-v3: AUC 0.76, recall@10 0.43 on holdout-2025q4 (n=1.2M, 2026-10-30); recall@10 stable 0.40–0.45 across monthly cohorts.

q: Why did AUC drop from 0.81 to 0.76 between churn-xgb-v2 and churn-xgb-v3?
key: v2's velocity features aggregated past the observation date (post-period leakage), inflating AUC to 0.81; without the leak AUC is 0.74 (exp-017); v3 with clean velocity gets an honest 0.76.

q: Who owns cards.txn_daily, and was there a data-quality issue with it?
key: data-eng-cards. September 2025 partitions were short by about 6%; the backfill finished 2026-10-27 (ticket DE-4411), so v2 numbers before then used ~6% fewer September transactions.

q: What are the current risk-tier cutoffs and are they still valid?
key: Churn score 0.20 and 0.50 (≥0.50 call, 3.8% of book; 0.20–0.50 email, 11.6%), set 2026-10-08 on churn-xgb-v2 scores. They stay until recalibrated, but q-recalibrate-tiers is open: churn-xgb-v3 scores are less extreme, so the call tier would shrink to ~2.9%.

q: How does the churn model do on new accounts?
key: churn-xgb-v2 on holdout-2025q4: AUC 0.69 for new accounts (< 6 months tenure, n=168k, 14%) vs 0.83 for the rest; finding: new accounts need their own treatment (tenure-specific model or route to onboarding, owner Priya Nair).

q: Are the utilization features affected by the target leak?
key: No. feat-utilization-check (2026-10-29): all 3 util_ columns of feat-utilization-v1 end on the observation date; keep it unchanged in v3 models.

q: Which models are trained on cards.churn_labels, and what is the churn base rate?
key: logreg-baseline, churn-xgb-v2 and churn-xgb-v3 (retrained monthly on the latest 9 observation months); churn rate 6.8% on the 2025 book (n=4.1M).
